annotation.title_clean: Artificial Intelligence Strategy for the Digital Government
annotation.title_en: Artificial Intelligence Strategy for the Digital Government
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Agesic (Agency for Electronic Government and Information and Knowledge Society), Uruguay
annotation.summary_en: Uruguay's Agesic strategy for responsible use of AI in public administration. It sets general principles (purpose, general interest, human rights, transparency, responsibility, privacy by design, security) and four pillars: governance, capacity development, responsible use, and digital citizenship, with eight objectives. No robotics content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Seven-plus general principles including transparency of algorithms and data, and an identifiable responsible person for each AI solution
Develop an AI governance model, maturity model, and AI observatory for public administration
Train 100% of Central Administration organizations under an AI training program
Define standards for impact analysis, auditing, and explainability of decision-making algorithms
Awareness campaigns to build citizen trust and knowledge of digital rights
